title: Organic Gardener's Composting (The Art of Sustainable Soil)
author: Steve Solomon
description:
Steve Solomon dives straight into the world of composting, revealing how this simple practice can transform your garden and your approach to growing food. Whether you’re a novice or a seasoned gardener, you'll discover the essential ingredients of successful composting, broken down into easy-to-follow steps. The audiobook not only covers the fundamental techniques but also explores the fascinating science behind decomposition, making it both informative and entertaining.

What sets this audiobook apart is its deep dive into vermiculture—composting with red worms. Solomon shares practical tips and tricks for harnessing these little powerhouses to enrich your soil. You’ll learn how to build your own composting units tailored to your space and needs, making this a hands-on guide that encourages experimentation.

But it’s not just about the how-to; Solomon intertwines the rich history of the organic gardening movement, connecting past practices to modern sustainability efforts. With an annotated bibliography included, you’ll have a roadmap to further explore the vast landscape of composting and food gardening.

Join Solomon on this journey to cultivate not just your garden, but a deeper understanding of nature's cycles. Get ready to dig into the art and science of composting and watch your gardening skills flourish!

As special needs moms, we need permission for EVERYTHING! Permission for services, funding, equipment, therapies, caregivers, and even the basic support our children deserve. From DDD and ALTCS to HCBS, foster care, adoption, and disability benefits, the paperwork, approvals, and endless waiting can make anyone want to lose it!

Through honest conversations, real-life experiences, humor, and a little frustration, we tackle the challenges of raising children with special needs and fighting for the support they deserve.

No judgment. No sugarcoating. Just real moms, real stories, and the freedom to lose it!

Because when you need permission for everything, sometimes you just need Permission to Lose It!

title: The Homebuyer Advantage
author: Tim Macy
description:
Buying a home is harder than it used to be. Prices are higher, mortgage rates have changed the monthly-payment math, starter homes are harder to find, and first-time buyers are entering the market later than ever.
But hard doesn't mean impossible.
Homebuyer Advantage is for people who want to understand the market, make smarter decisions, and buy a home with a real strategy.
When I was actively selling homes every week, I noticed that certain buyers were simply better prepared. They understood their finances, knew the market, had the right team around them, and understood the buying process. Those buyers had an advantage.
That's the Homebuyer Advantage.
In this podcast, we'll break down affordability, mortgages, monthly payments, neighborhoods, inspections, negotiating, choosing an agent and lender, knowing when you're overpaying, and everything else you need to make a confident homebuying decision.
The goal isn't to convince you to buy a house.
It's to make sure that when the time is right for you, you know exactly what you're doing.

I’m Vinay Parmar, and for thirty years, from the frontline to the boardroom, that question has fascinated me. I’ve found the answer isn’t only in the moments on the frontline. It’s in the engine room. 


What customers feel on the outside is a reflection of what’s happening on the inside.In every episode I sit down with one guest from a different business, sector or discipline, and we explore what drives those moments from the inside out.

No selling. No pitching. No product placement. Just a real conversation about what earns loyalty, what quietly destroys it, and what leaders can do differently on Monday morning.

If you lead a team, run a business, or you’re just curious why some customers stick and others don’t, you’re in the right place.

description:

​In this guide, we strip away confusing jargon and show you how to inspect ingredient lists, spot hidden industrial seed oils, and choose traditional, heat-stable cooking fats for your home.

​Key topics covered:

• Industrial Oils to Avoid: Partially hydrogenated fats (vanaspati), refined palm olein, hexane-extracted cottonseed oil, and high-Omega-6 soybean and corn oils.

• Healthy Traditional Alternatives: A2 Bilona Desi Cow Ghee, cold-pressed Kachi Ghani Mustard Oil, unrefined Virgin Coconut Oil, Chekku Groundnut Oil, and Extra Virgin Olive Oil.

• The Deceptive Label Decoder: What terms like "Edible Vegetable Oil," "Blended Vegetable Oil," "0g Trans Fat," and "Interesterified Fat" actually mean on the back of a package.

• Cómo elegir a tu Host Family y convivir con ella sin perderte en el camino. 

• La mentalidad y la adaptación cultural que hacen la diferencia en el día a día. 


Soy Yanimar Best, ex-Au Pair: viví 6 años y medio con mi Host Family y llevo 8 años viviendo en Estados Unidos, ligada al mundo Au Pair. Además trabajé 2 años como LCC (Local Community Counselor), acompañando de cerca a host families y au pairs durante su tiempo juntos. Hoy doy mentorías a futuras y actuales au pairs que quieren vivir su experiencia sin sentirse solas ni perdidas en el proceso.

Autistic, ADHD, selective mutism……. and I started a podcast. Bold choice.

I'm Ginnie, and this is a funny, honest neurodivergent podcast about late discovery autism and ADHD, masking, motherhood and leadership. Mother, daughter, sister, partner, business owner, leader: lovely labels, but none of them is actually me. So every week I take the boxes away and figure out what my brain has been doing for thirty-two years without telling me.

Expect real stories, a running commentary on human behaviour, and a host who thinks business cards are just anxiety with a nice font.

On the show, I talk about:
• Late discovery autism and ADHD in adults, especially women
• Selective mutism, and why quiet is not the same as empty
• Masking, burnout, sensory overload, and slowly unmasking
• Being a neurodivergent mom and raising kids who know their brains aren't broken
• Leading a team and running a business with an AuDHD brain
• Identity, self discovery and mental health, without the clinical jargon
• Family, relationships and chosen family
• The awkward, hilarious and occasionally baffling rules of being a human around other humans

This podcast is for late diagnosed and self discovering autistic and ADHD adults, neurodivergent women and moms, leaders who are great at work and exhausted at home, quiet people who have a lot to say, and anyone who's been called too much and not enough in the same week. It's also for parents, partners, friends and coworkers who want to understand the neurodivergent people they love.

I'm not a doctor or a therapist. I'm just Ginnie, sharing my own experience so you feel a little less alone and a lot more curious.

New episodes every Tuesday. Follow the show so you don't miss one, and if an episode makes you feel seen, a rating or a share helps other quiet people find it.

Questions, stories or episode ideas: contact@justginnie.com

Each episode brings helpful knowledge, fresh perspectives, and simple ideas to help you make informed health decisions and build better daily habits. Whether you're looking to improve your lifestyle, understand your body, find balance, or take better care of yourself and your family, HealthCare Zone is here to keep you informed, motivated, and inspired. So… who let us have a podcast?

Come meet Maddie and Graci. In this episode you’ll learn a little bit about us and get an idea of what this podcast will be about! We can’t wait for you guys to get to know us throughout this journey and share our love of books with you all!

title: ANGRY GRIOTS
author: Uwabunkoye
description:
History has been softened, sanitized, and sometimes silenced.


Angry Griots refuses to stay quiet.


This is a bold, unapologetic audio series that tells African history with fire in its voice. Drawing on the ancient role of the griot as truth-teller and memory-keeper, each episode delivers powerful, cinematic storytelling that confronts the full weight of the past the glory of great empires, the brilliance of African civilizations, and the rage, resistance, and resilience that shaped the continent through conquest, slavery, colonialism, and liberation.


From the warrior queens and scholar-kings to the uprisings that refused to die, Angry Griots speaks with passion, precision, and pride. Expect vivid narration, rich historical detail, and a tone that doesn’t flinch.


These are not polite lessons. These are stories told with urgency the kind that demand to be heard.


The ancestors are not whispering.


They’re raising their voices.


Listen to Angry Griots.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: The Aging Playbook
author: Dawn Spaulding, Nora Diaz Bretherton
description:
Caring for aging parents or planning for your own future? You don’t have to figure it all out alone. We’re Nora Diaz Bretherton and Dawn Spaulding, two elder care professionals bringing you honest conversations, real stories, and practical guidance on aging and caregiving. With expert guests, we explore home care, aging in place, hospital discharge, family dynamics, and end-of-life planning. Whether you’re supporting a loved one or aging on your own, we’ll help you understand your options, ask better questions, and feel more prepared for what comes next.


Join us every Wednesday for an all-new episode of, The Aging Playbook!

title: Built To Own | With Harmony Brownwood & Michael Craycraft
author: Harmony Brownwood & Michael Craycraft
description:
What if everything you've been told about homeownership is wrong?


The American Dream isn't dead. The system behind it might be broken.

We've been taught to accept 30 years of debt, rising costs, and the idea that homeownership must come with financial sacrifice.


But who decided that's the only way?


Built to Own challenges the rules nobody questions.

Through bold conversations with entrepreneurs, innovators, and leaders, we expose outdated thinking, explore emerging technologies like AI, and challenge what's possible.


Our mission? Zero-Cost Homeownership. A future where your home creates enough value to potentially pay for itself.


We're not here to repeat what everyone already believes. We're here to question it, find evidence, and build something better.


If you're comfortable with the way things are, this podcast might not be for you.


But if you believe ownership should create freedom instead of decades of financial pressure, you're exactly where you belong.


Stop accepting the system. Start questioning what's possible.

description:
One night you’re out at a convention in Ohio. The next, Earth has been repossessed, and the only way to win it back is to survive an 18-floor dungeon built for entertainment. Welcome to Dungeon Crawlers, a comedic actual play set in the world of Dungeon Crawler Carl and played with the Dungeon Crawler Carl tabletop RPG. Four friends play themselves while GM Adam plays the dungeon, the AI, and every questionable NPC. New episodes drop every other Monday. Part of the Majestic Goose Network. Contains explicit language.

Dungeon Crawlers is an unofficial, fan-made show inspired by the Dungeon Crawler Carl books by Matt Dinniman. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the author or the publishers of the books or the tabletop RPG.

Pastor Yongliu Jiang is the founder of New Life International Ministries. His preaching and ministry focus on the power of the Holy Spirit, the life of faith, healing and deliverance, and resurrection life.
He leads believers around the world to experience the resurrection power of Jesus Christ and to witness signs and wonders as the Holy Spirit moves.
🌍 Follow the show and step out in faith: receive the anointing of the Holy Spirit, healing for your body, and renewal for your soul.

title: The Children (Themes of Innocence and Growth)
author: Edith Wharton
description:
When the wealthy and sheltered Martin Boyne crosses paths with the enigmatic and spirited Nan St. George, he finds himself drawn into a world where innocence clashes with the harsh realities of society. Edith Wharton's 'Children' explores the tangled web of desire, ambition, and the burdens of adulthood through the eyes of a young man wrestling with his own identity and aspirations. As Martin becomes increasingly entangled in Nan's life and her family's expectations, he faces a critical choice: embrace the constraints of his privileged upbringing or forge his own path toward authenticity.

Listeners will journey through the intricate dynamics of early 20th-century society, where the constraints of social class and gender roles shape destinies. Wharton masterfully delves into themes of personal freedom, the loss of innocence, and the paradoxes of love and longing. As Martin navigates the complexities of his feelings for Nan, he uncovers profound truths about himself and the world around him.

With keen observations and rich character development, 'Children' invites you to ponder the sacrifices demanded by society and the quest for genuine connection. Discover how one young man’s internal conflict reflects a universal struggle, making this audiobook a timeless exploration of human experience. Tune in to witness the delicate balance between expectation and desire, and find out how choices made in the name of love can ripple through lives in unexpected ways.

title: 4P's In A Pod
author: Kimberly Bovia Brown
description:
Four peas. One pod. A whole lot of opinions.

Two Gen Zs, a Millennial, and a Gen Xer walk into a conversation. Sounds like the beginning of a joke, right? Well, depending on who's talking, somebody might actually BE the joke.

Welcome to 4P's in a Pod, where four women, three generations, and absolutely no shortage of opinions collide. Think group chat energy, except somebody gave us microphones and nobody thought to supervise.

From love, relationships, and dating disasters to pop culture, questionable life choices, and the everyday foolishness that makes you wonder if common sense is still common—we've got questions, comments, and concerns.

We've got a Gen Xer who's seen it all, a Millennial who's tired of seeing it, and two Gen Zs who are convinced the rest of us have been doing life wrong this entire time.

Somebody's dropping wisdom. Somebody's challenging it. Somebody's offended. And somebody's Googling to see who's actually right.

We're bringing the laughs, the life lessons, the side-eye, and enough unsolicited opinions to make Thanksgiving dinner uncomfortable.

Will we agree? Probably not.

Will we change your mind? Maybe.

Will somebody say something they probably should've kept to themselves? Absolutely.

So whether you're old school, new school, or still trying to figure out what school you're in, pull up a seat. There's room for everybody in this pod.

Four peas. One pod. A whole lot of opinions.

Come for the conversation. Stay for the peas.

description: Built for Brotherhood is a practical discipleship podcast for everyday men in the local church. Not a culture-war commentary show. Not a theology lecture. title: End-Times Now!
author: Paul T. Barham
description: End-Times Now! is a Bible-centered look at the last days, hosted by author Paul T. Barham. Wars, earthquakes, a Doomsday Clock at 85 seconds to midnight: many feel the world is nearing its end, and the Bible agrees it will. Each episode opens Scripture to ask what God has actually said about the rapture, the Tribulation, the return of Jesus and the new heaven and new earth. Every verse is read aloud, every view is treated fairly, and every episode ends with the hope of the Gospel. No date-setting, no sensationalism, just the Word.

title: The Way of Love
author: Hanna Sheff
description: What if love isn't just something we feel—but a way we're meant to live?  And what if learning God's way of love transformed the way you  communicate, the way you relate, and the way you experience life?  Welcome to The Way of Love Podcast. I'm your host, Hanna Dylan.  For nearly a decade, I've been helping women rediscover their voice,  communicate with confidence, build healthier relationships, and step into  the woman God created them to be.  Every week, we'll explore raw and real conversations, and heartfelt stories  that will shape your faith and transform your relationships.   My prayer and intention is that you walk away from each episode with  practical tools, fresh perspectives, and a renewed desire to communicate  with grace, love more deeply, and learn how to keep God at the center of  every aspect of your life.  I'm so grateful you're here. So take a deep breath... yes, actually take one.  Get cozy, bring an open heart & mind, and let's walk the Way of Love  together. Follow us now on Apple, Spotify, YouTube, or wherever you enjoy your podcasts.

title: The Pick 'Em Room

description:
Welcome to The Pick ’Em Room, where four personalities bring bold predictions, heated debates, and unfiltered opinions to the biggest matchups in sports!


Hosted by Mamba, MG, DJ Hope, and Quincy, The Pick ’Em Room delivers entertaining breakdowns of NFL and college football games, betting lines, potential upsets, and must-watch matchups.


From picking winners and debating point spreads to calling out surprise upsets, the crew brings different perspectives, competitive energy, and plenty of trash talk to every episode.

From playing and watching soccer to big games, favorite players, hot takes, trivia, challenges, and plenty of friendly debates, every episode is a chance to laugh, learn, and celebrate their love of soccer together.

title: ProProcess
author: Archie Aves
description:
What does it actually take to become a professional footballer?
I’m Archie Aves. I played professionally at Notts County, and that question has shaped almost my entire life. After years of injuries held back my development and I was released, I found myself asking it again as I work my way back into the game.
On ProProcess, I sit down with the coaches and specialists behind some of the world’s best footballers. We get into what they work on with elite players, why it matters, and what you can take into your own game. No hacks. Just what it takes to become a pro.

title: Minority Possible
author: Joel Polley
description:
*Minority Possible is about changing what gets inherited.*
Health. Wealth. Relationships. They are not separate conversations. What happens in one part of your life eventually touches the others.
Hosted by nurses, entrepreneurs, husband and wife *Joel and Annie* , Minority Possible explores how ordinary people can live well, own more, love better, and leave better.
We talk health, family, marriage, money, ownership, business, culture, faith, legacy, and the patterns that get passed from one generation to the next.
Some episodes are just us at the kitchen table. Others bring in experts, builders, first-generation success stories, and people whose lives prove that the way things have always been is not the way they have to stay.
Because family history is information, not a sentence.
*Your future does not have to look like your past.*
Welcome to *Minority Possible.*
*Change what gets inherited.*

Welcome to I'M JUST SAYING, a rollicking, free-form podcast coming to you from somewhere between the Atlantic Coast and Los Angeles.
Two anonymous voices with plenty to say about just about everything. From the ridiculous to the sublime, current events to everyday absurdities, and whatever else wanders into the conversation.
No scripts. No agenda. No telling where this thing is going.

Join two curious AI hosts as they explore the surprising history, unusual discoveries, remarkable people, and wonderfully obscure subjects found in the vast world of Wikipedia.
From forgotten historical events to scientific curiosities, peculiar inventions, and stories you've probably never heard, each episode turns an unexpected topic into an entertaining conversation.

Storybook adventures for children aged 6–9. A new case every Saturday.

We revisit real-life cases, uncover disturbing details, explore compelling evidence, and break down the twists and turns behind some of the world's most talked-about crimes.
From cold cases and serial killers to shocking family tragedies and criminal investigations, every episode takes you deeper into the stories that captured headlines and left the world searching for answers.

title: The Culture Reform Podcast: Scripture for the Christian life and the world we live in

description:
Scripture for the Christian life and the world we live in.
Most Christians learn their Bible on Sunday and live the rest of the week by everything else. The Culture Reform takes one passage at a time and asks what it meant to the people who first heard it, what it reveals about God and human nature, and what it means for the society we share. Then it asks the question that matters most: how should Christians faithfully respond?
Hosted by Beto Medrano, a seminarian and former pastor who has spent years helping people and churches make disciples. Produced by The Culture Reform.

description:
Entrepreneur | Authorities is where founders, CEOs, and business leaders learn how to become the trusted voices in their industries.

Hosted by Erik Cabral and powered by the Entrepreneur Magazine brand, each episode features conversations with entrepreneurs, authors, creators, and thought leaders who are building businesses with influence and intention.

From personal branding and content strategy to publishing, leadership, and business growth, the show unpacks the real stories and practical lessons behind modern authority-building.

Whether you’re scaling a company, growing your audience, or preparing to write your first book, Entrepreneur Authorities gives you the insights, frameworks, and inspiration to help you stand out in a crowded market.

title: In Another Light: Reflections on Chinese History
author: CX History
description:

description: Life's not easy for Doug Eiffel, the communications officer for the U.S.S. Hephaestus Research Station, currently on Day 448 of its orbit around red dwarf star Wolf 359. He's stuck on a scientific survey mission of indeterminate length, 7.8 light years from Earth. His only company on board the station are stern mission chief Minkowski, insane science officer Hilbert, and Hephaestus Station's sentient, often malfunctioning operating system Hera. He doesn't have much to do for his job other than monitoring static and intercepting the occasional decades-old radio broadcast from Earth, so he spends most of his time creating extensive audio logs about the ordinary, day-to-day happenings within the station. But the Hephaestus is an odd place, and life in extremely isolated, zero gravity conditions has a way of doing funny things to people's minds. Even the simplest of tasks can turn into a gargantuan struggle, and the most ordinary-seeming things have a way of turning into anything but that. THE DRAGON’S MERIDIAN
Where Ancient Myth Bleeds into Reality.History records the dates, but myth remembers the truth.In the West, dragons were monsters slain for gold. But across the mist-shrouded gorges, jade rivers, and subterranean calderas of the East, dragons were never beasts to be conquered—they were the living architecture of the world itself.Hosted by Michael Mattie, The Dragon’s Meridian is an immersive, cinematic audio journey into the deepest and darkest corridors of Asian mythology, folklore, and primordial fantasy. Each week, step off the edge of the charted map to encounter shapeshifting nine-tailed spirits, ancient flood-tamers, eight-headed river hydras, and the hidden kings of the sunken seas. Blending rigorous mythological research, forgotten historical chronicles, and visceral, novelistic storytelling, this is folklore stripped of its fairy-tale varnish—raw, psychological, and breathtakingly alive.About the Host:
Michael Mattie is an American narrative folklorist, cultural archivist, and audio storyteller with an obsession for the liminal spaces where geography meets human belief. Having spent years tracking folklore across remote mountain temples, volcanic riverbanks, and classical Taoist and Buddhist pilgrimage routes, Michael brings a warm, cinematic authority and a philosopher’s eye to the microphone. Known for his hypnotic cadence and deep respect for cultural nuance, he doesn't just recite old legends—he reconstructs the psychological world of the ancestors who dared to look into the mist and see a living god staring back.Inside Every Journey:
  • Cinematic Soundscapes: Atmospheric, high-fidelity storytelling built for headphones at midnight.
  • The True History Behind the Myth: The real megafloods, imperial secrets, and volcanic events that birthed ancient monsters.
  • Listener Inquiries: Deep-dive answers exploring the hidden philosophy, psychology, and anatomy of the supernatural.
Close your eyes. Turn down the lights. Follow the current into the deep.
